    add_mat(o,material)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True

def lathe(name, loc, profile, material, seg=28):
    # profile: list of (r,z) bottom->top, creates surface of revolution + caps if r=0 ends given
    verts=[]; faces=[]
    rings=[]
    for (r,z) in profile:
        ring=[]
        for i in range(seg):
            a=2*math.pi*i/seg
            ring.append(len(verts)); verts.append((r*math.cos(a), r*math.sin(a), z))
        rings.append(ring)
    for k in range(len(rings)-1):
        for i in range(seg):
            a=rings[k][i]; b=rings[k][(i+1)%seg]; c=rings[k+1][(i+1)%seg]; d=rings[k+1][i]
            faces.append((a,b,c,d))
    # cap top/bottom center if radius>0.001
    def cap(ring, z, flip):
        ci=len(verts); verts.append((0,0,z))
        for i in range(seg):
            a=ring[i]; b=ring[(i+1)%seg]
            faces.append((ci,b,a) if flip else (ci,a,b))
    if profile[0][0]>0.001: cap(rings[0], profile[0][1], True)
    if profile[-1][0]>0.001: cap(rings[-1], profile[-1][1], False)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+'Mesh'); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(o); o.location=loc
    add_mat(o,material)
    for p in me.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

    if o.name.startswith(('Steam','HeldSteam')):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)

def curve_tube(name, points, bevel, material):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name+'Curve','CURVE'); cu.dimensions='3D'
    cu.bevel_depth=bevel; cu.bevel_resolution=3; cu.resolution_u=12; cu.fill_mode='FULL'
    sp=cu.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for bp,co in zip(sp.bezier_points, points):
        bp.co=co; bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(o)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o; o.select_set(True); bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    if o.data and hasattr(o.data,'materials'): o.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    o.select_set(False); return o

steam=bpy.data.materials['Steam']

spots=[(-1.25,-0.30,1.48),(1.20,-0.38,1.48),(-0.95,-0.06,1.60),(1.45,0.85,1.52)]
